Maya: AM async — quick check (what I did / blockers / today). Doing a light sync for this week's launches: routing v2 canary (Thu), embed-cache tweaks (Fri). What I did: finalized rollout timeline and updated the rollout checklist. Blockers: waiting on high-seq perf numbers for model variant A. Today: need spec signoff + pick smoke-test owners.

Jon: Frontend update — wired up canary flag UI and feature gate. What I did: PR #342 created, needs a quick review. Blockers: API contract change about session_id optional flag. @Alex can you confirm behavior? Today: will address review comments and add e2e for the flag.

Alex: Backend: merged the contract change into staging earlier today, behavior keeps session_id optional (falls back to generated id). What I did: fixed session routing bug and ran basic load test. Blockers: need the exact error-code mapping doc from Maya for client-side handling. Today: will kick off the 20k-seq perf run and post results in this thread.

Priya: Infra: reserved a small extra pool for Thu canary and bumped autoscaler min to 2 instances for safety. What I did: prepared a rollback playbook and smoke infra checks. Blockers: keys rotation scheduled 11:00 PT which might cause ~3-5m connection failures during rotation window. Today: I'll coordinate rotation time with deploy window and set up alerting.

Sam: Design: uploaded the canary banners and fallback copy to Figma. What I did: reviewed error states and added tiny UX tweaks for degraded results. Blockers: one copy tweak on soft-fallback messaging — left comment in Figma. Today: will finalize copy after Maya signoff.

Maya: Thanks all. Quick asks: @Jon please tag PR reviewers and rebase; @Alex post the perf numbers when ready; @Priya please confirm rotation timing (avoid 11:00 if possible). For smoke-test owners, volunteers?

Jon: I can own frontend smoke tests. Will run manual flows after deploy and attach screenshots.

Alex: I'll own backend smoke tests and do the perf dump. ETA ~2h.

Priya: I can watch the deploy and handle infra rollbacks if needed. Recommend moving keys rotation to 13:00 PT to avoid overlap.

Maya: OK moving rotation to 13:00 PT works for me. Adding quick rollout snippet and checklist for visibility:

```
# rollout checklist
- confirm canary capacity reserved
- run smoke tests (frontend/backend)
- watch 5m latency SLO and error spikes
- rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained for 2m
```

Maya: Deploy window proposed 14:00 PT. If no objections by 13:30 PT we'll promote. Please add :thumbsup: if good.

Jon: :thumbsup:

Maya: Great — I'll post post-deploy checklist and owner pings in here once we start.
